title: Alleviation of phosphorus rather than nitrogen limitation driven by permafrost and landscape effects on Dahurian larch forests
content:
Read the free Plain Language Summary for this article on the Journal blog.


Abstract

Permafrost thaw is reshaping nutrient dynamics in boreal forests, but its impacts on tree nutrient limitation and functional strategies remain poorly understood. Clarifying these responses is crucial for predicting the response of boreal forests to climate change. We investigated the stoichiometric and functional traits of Dahurian larch at the southern edge of the Eurasian permafrost zone. We compared uplands (active layer thickness, ALT >100 cm, dry) and lowland swamps (ALT <60 cm, wet) to examine variations in tree and soil nutrient status, and assessed the relative importance of climate and local soil factors in driving tree nutrient variations. Our results showed that upland larches had higher phosphorus (P) and potassium (K) concentrations, lower carbon to phosphorus (C:P) and nitrogen to phosphorus (N:P) ratios, and similar N contents compared with lowland trees. Upland soils exhibited lower C and N contents but higher K content than swamps, whereas P levels did not differ significantly (p > 0.05). Climate and soil variables explained 34.2% and 26.6% of the variation in larch stoichiometry, respectively, and their interaction accounted for 4.4% of the variation. Upland larches with deeper ALT displayed more acquisitive functional traits, as they tended to have higher leaf P content, greater specific leaf area, and lower leaf dry matter content than in lowland swamps. Our findings suggest that instead of N, deeper permafrost thaw and drier soil on uplands can increase the availability of P and K, promoting acquisitive strategies in upland larches. Our findings illustrate how permafrost and landscape factors alter nutrient limitation and boreal tree strategies in the rapidly changing climate.

摘要

多年冻土退化正在重塑北方针叶林的养分动态，但其对树木养分限制和功能策略的影响仍不清楚。阐明这些响应对于预测气候变化背景下北方森林的未来趋势至关重要。 本研究聚焦于欧亚多年冻土区南缘的兴安落叶松，对其生态化学计量特征和功能性状进行了研究。通过对比高地(活动层厚度ALT >100 cm)与低洼沼泽(ALT <60 cm)，本研究分析了树木和土壤养分状况的变化，并评估了气候与局地土壤因素在驱动树木养分变异中的重要性。 结果表明，与低洼沼泽相比，高地落叶松各器官具有更高的磷(P)和钾(K)浓度，更低的碳磷比(C:P)和氮磷比(N:P)，而氮(N)含量则无显著差异。高地土壤的碳、氮含量虽低于沼泽，但钾含量较高，而两者之间的磷水平并无显著差异(p > 0.05)。气候和土壤变量分别解释了落叶松化学计量特征变异的34.2%和26.6%，两者的交互作用解释了4.4%。在活动层更深的高地上，落叶松表现出更倾向于获取型(acquisitive)的功能性状——更高的叶片磷含量、更大的比叶面积(SLA)，和更低的叶干物质含量(LDMC)。 研究结果表明，更深的多年冻土融化以及高地更干燥的土壤条件未能提升氮的有效性，但能够提高磷和钾的有效性，促进了高地落叶松采取更具获取型特点的生长策略。本研究揭示了在全球气候变化下，多年冻土和地形因素对北方森林树木养分限制状态与生态策略的共同影响。
